create_typo_augmenter_charmix: create a TypoAugmenter with charmix typo type to randomly delete insert substitute and swap characters in text
create_typo_augmenter_keyboard: create a TypoAugmenter with keyboard typo type to swap characters with adjacent QWERTY keyboard keys
create_typo_augmenter_misspelling: create a TypoAugmenter with misspelling typo type using a JSON dictionary file to replace words with misspellings
create_typo_augmenter_all: create a TypoAugmenter with all typo type combining charmix keyboard and misspelling augmentations on text
review_misspelling_replacement_class: review the MisspellingReplacement class that loads a JSON dictionary and replaces words with their misspellings
